sources.citation: Ravi Sankar S. Nair. 2013. Tribal Languages of Kerala. Language in India 13(7) (July 2013), 58 pp.
sources.note: Nothing about Allar. Sketches 13 Kerala tribal languages (Adiya, Aranadan, Bettakurumba, Cholanaickan, Irula, Kakkala, Kani, Kurichiya, Malamuthan, Malaveda, Mannan, Muduga, Mullukurumba); Allar is mentioned once ethnographically (p. 36, pollution distances from Malamuthan houses) and is not described.
